recoveryMatrix.rust: tool output is rollout history; no durable provider receipt protocol

recoveryMatrix.workflowTs: unknown node outcome; never blind re-POST
recoveryMatrix.rust: in-process stream retry only; cross-process certainty is unavailable

recoveryMatrix.ordinaryTs: new durable Attempt retrieves predecessor response
recoveryMatrix.workflowTs: checkpoint belongs to admitted Attempt; continuation work is separately owned

identityAndBounds.segmentId: stable inside one model sample; a continuation sample gets a distinct segment
identityAndBounds.attempt: stream retries stay inside the parent Attempt; process recovery may create a retry Attempt
identityAndBounds.eventSequence: strictly increasing per segment and canonicalized before durable projection
identityAndBounds.providerState: provider checkpoint and provider turn state are durable before continuation
identityAndBounds.toolHistory: tool calls and results are canonical pairs and are bounded by context item/byte limits

redesigns: Rust has no TS durable Run/Step/Attempt identity or cross-process model-dispatch receipt.
Workflow settlement is node-scoped and must not settle the root Run.
Workflow durable continuation ownership is audited separately while that implementation is in flight.
